logs.message: Not updating DXMT copy of Wine-Staging-macOS-9: <TOOLS>/wine/Wine-Staging-macOS-9-DXMT/Contents/Resources/wine/lib/wine/x86_64-unix/winemac.so winemac.so lacks the macdrv metal-view exports; missing _macdrv_functions, _macdrv_view_create_metal_view, _macdrv_view_get_metal_layer, _macdrv_view_release_metal_view. DXMT v0.80 needs _macdrv_functions or all three _macdrv_view_*_metal_* exports, so D3D11 games could not present on it. Existing -DXMT copies are left untouched.
